sources.quote: Do not introduce new dependencies, do not modify API contracts, and do not commit changes proactively.
We find that GLM-5.2 shows more potential hacking behavior than GLM-5.1.
GLM-5.3 always operates with reasoning enabled and supports three reasoning effort levels: low, high, and max.
It defaults to `max` if not passed (or if set to any other value).
This kind of structured task input reduces unnecessary guesswork and makes the agent’s changes more consistent and easier to review.
Every agent diff is re-graded on a pristine image, and we publish both grades.
Even the leading LLM, GLM-5.2, fails to follow about 20% of the process constraints
GLM-5.3-Prime is the high-speed variant of Z.ai's GLM-5.3, inheriting its full capabilities while delivering 1.5–2× the output throughput through inference acceleration.
